purpose: Stress-test specification, not an execution result or a theorem check

fql.baseline_requirement: same backlog, pipeline, order caps and terminal rule

source_gate: Teaching adaptation tests do not close the final-published replication gate
mimic_ql.baseline_requirement: same nondiscarding dynamics; choose after source verification
mimic_ql.source_version: Author MIT thesis June 2023, earlier than final published article
mimic_ql.candidate_scope: finite teaching values only; J9 requires resource review; no theorem claim
mimic_ql.clocks: both advance on each shared physical-period demand
mimic_ql.implementation_current: Explicitly bounded Mimic-QL-inspired teaching adaptation; not faithful published replication

statistical_contract.fixed_profile_panel: aggregate within seed before paired seed bootstrap unless another blocked design is predeclared
statistical_contract.primary_outcome: paired cost difference within matched physics and evaluation regime
statistical_contract.multiplicity: lock Holm or Bonferroni and primary family before test
statistical_contract.relative_effect_zero_denominator: report undefined and use absolute difference; never assign equivalence
statistical_contract.tail_metrics: need adequate tail samples and training-run uncertainty
statistical_contract.frozen_policy: lock Q, running sets, normalizers and action/scheduling rule; no test updates
statistical_contract.oracle_validation: Independent scalar Bellman/enumeration on small cases; disclose known-distribution versus hindsight; no optimality-gap label without a verified matched oracle

proposed_factors.factorial_policy: one-factor controlled sweeps, then a small justified interaction panel; no automatic full Cartesian product

mimic_artificial_cycle.published_values: defer until final-source verification; finite teaching values are not theorem construction

failure_policy: persist first failing seed/step/config and minimal trace; do not silently remove failed seeds or reduce grid
